desc: convert an Atari Degas .pi1 into a PPM image
r: pi1toppm - convert an Atari Degas .pi1 into a PPM image

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

pi1toppm reads an Atari Degas .pi1 file as input and produces a PPM image as output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for pi1toppm, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
